card.name: Linking words before a group or topic
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, for, on, to, which) that come right before a group of people or a subject area, in general web prose. Also the sentence-opening 'Yet'.

modes.label: Preposition before a group or subject
modes.description: A preposition such as of, for, on or to follows a noun or verb and is followed by a people group or topic.
modes.example: This database includes full-text digital resources that explore the history and culture<< of>> African Americans.

modes.label: Contrast word 'Yet'
modes.description: The word Yet opens a sentence that turns against the previous claim.
modes.example: His declaration that the frontier was closed or quickly closing soon became a vital part of the American creed. <<Yet>> the American frontier stayed mostly intact after

card.writes: The promoted tokens are a mix of unrelated words, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on little linking words like of, for and on just before the text names a group of people or a subject.
